data.name: Etherwind
data.detailed_description:
Etherwind is a small-scale 3D side-scrolling MMORPG focused on cooperative play, flexible character building, and long-term progression across multiple lives.

Explore a persistent shared world of towns, wilderness regions, dungeons, and instanced challenges. Meet other players naturally while adventuring, trade with the community, form parties, and work together toward shared goals.

Gameplay & World

Etherwind is a PvE-focused MMORPG with no player-versus-player combat. Fight monsters, complete quests, take on jobs, explore dungeons, and participate in cooperative activities across interconnected maps.

Most content can be approached alone or with a party, but cooperation is meaningfully rewarded. Party members can share experience and objectives, earn improved activity rewards, and gain access to progression benefits designed around active participation rather than simply being present.

The world is persistent and shared, allowing players to regularly encounter others progressing alongside them, form temporary or long-term groups, and take part in an active in-game community.

Character Progression

Etherwind features a rebirth-based progression system built around repeated leveling journeys.

During each life, players choose a class, gain levels, learn and master skills, improve their stats, and acquire equipment. Upon reaching the rebirth point, they may begin a new life as another class while retaining permanent character growth earned across previous lives.

Skills do not automatically carry over after rebirth. However, Legacy Points earned through gameplay can be used to preserve selected skills, allowing characters to gradually combine abilities from different classes and develop increasingly specialized builds.

Classes define the starting direction of each life rather than permanently locking a character into one role. Over time, a character’s identity is shaped by stat allocation, equipment, class choices, and the skills preserved across rebirths.

This allows players to experiment with new playstyles, change roles, and build toward unique long-term combinations, without "re-rolling" a new character.

Development Status

Etherwind is currently a solo-developed project with an emphasis on enjoyable gameplay, meaningful cooperation, and community building rather than aggressive monetization.

The game is currently in active development, with Early Access planned. Its core gameplay systems are being implemented before Early Access, while balance, pacing, content, presentation, and polish will continue to evolve through development and player feedback.

Players interested in following development, providing feedback, or participating in future testing are encouraged to join the official Discord, where development updates and design discussions are shared regularly.

For inquiries, contact the developer at missvalkyrie@accidentalcube.com.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or equivalent
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
